description: Salesforce supplies cloud-based customer relationship management applications and related tools that help organizations manage customer-facing work. Its platform also incorporates AI agents and business data.
Linear develops a software product that helps teams plan, coordinate, and deliver product development work. It provides a shared system for organizing work across teams and agents.
Boeing develops, manufactures, and services commercial airplanes, defense products, and space systems. Its businesses include commercial aircraft, defense and space, and related services.
Boom Supersonic is developing the Overture supersonic airliner and its Symphony engine. Its work centers on creating aircraft and propulsion technology for future passenger travel.

The Coca-Cola Company is a beverage business with a portfolio that includes soft drinks, water, sports drinks, coffee, and tea. It develops and markets beverage brands within a broader bottling and distribution system.
Liquid Death markets packaged drinks including still water, sparkling water, iced tea, and energy drinks. It also sells branded merchandise.
Visa operates a digital payments network connecting consumers, merchants, financial institutions, and other organizations. It facilitates payments through its network and related technology services.
Modern Treasury provides payment infrastructure that helps businesses move and track money. Its platform offers an API spanning bank-based payments and stablecoins, with related ledger capabilities.
Pfizer is a biopharmaceutical business that develops and supplies medicines and vaccines. Its work includes scientific research and the development of treatments for disease.
Formation Bio acquires clinical-stage drug assets and develops potential treatments. It uses a proprietary technology and AI platform to improve the drug development process.
